description: This file defines the ImportMapOther class, which manages import settings and field mappings for different modules in the SuiteCRM application. It contains methods for retrieving default field mappings and ignored fields based on the module.

classes.name: ImportMapOther
classes.description: A class handling import configurations, including field delimiters, headers, and module-specific import mappings.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns a preset array of field mappings for the specified module (e.g., Contacts, Leads, Accounts, Opportunities).

methods.name: getIgnoredFields
methods.description: Provides a list of fields to be ignored during import for a given module.
